announcement.msg_id: ARA 4.9.5 — Lampu SketchUp lebih ringan: Lampu Bidang tampil biasa saat bekerja dan menyala penuh otomatis saat gambar ditangkap (Ekspor, Potret 360, kirim ke ARA). Tiap klik langsung jadi lampu. Lampu Indirek di garis tegak tidak lagi gagal. Mohon perbarui: unduh di github.com/gigihwicaksono09-spec/ARA_AURUM/releases (SmartScreen: More info → Run anyway).
announcement.msg_en: ARA 4.9.5 — lighter SketchUp lights: Glowing Surface lights look normal while you work and light up automatically when an image is captured (Export, 360 Capture, send to ARA). Every click makes a light right away. Indirect Light on vertical lines no longer fails. Please update: download at github.com/gigihwicaksono09-spec/ARA_AURUM/releases (SmartScreen: More info → Run anyway).
